entries.heading: Section 422 of division F of
ancestors: DIVISION G—DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 426.  Section 422 of division F of 
Public Law 110-161 (121 Stat 1844), as amended, shall be applied by 
substituting ``fiscal year 2021'' for ``fiscal year 2019''.

[[Page 134 STAT. 1542]]
